newsitem.title: USA: Modine sees possible 10 pct profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Modine sees possible 10 pct profit growth.

text.p: Modine Manufacturing Co said Wednesday its margins are increasing as expected and a 10 percent increase in earnings is possible in its current fiscal year.

"If our markets remain strong, with the economies of the United States and Europe continuing to hold up, fiscal-year earnings growth of about 10 percent is achievable on the more modest sales increase that we expect," Donald Johnson, president and chief operating officer, said in a statement.
On Wednesday, Modine reported fiscal first quarter earnings of $0.60 a share versus $0.54. The company said sales increased in five of its six major markets.
Modine makes heat-transfer systems for the vehicular, industrial commercial and building markets.
